_comment: Locked model lineup for the RQ2 capability-ladder experiment (task 1.10, relocked 2026-08-27). Supersedes the earlier gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna lock: switched to an all-GPT-5.4 ladder so every tier carries a real dated/pinned snapshot ID, while keeping the single-provider/single-generation design (see docs/model_snapshot_verification.md). API keys stay in .env (gitignored), never here.

tiers.name: nano
tiers.notes: Cheapest GPT-5.4-class tier, for simple high-volume tasks per OpenAI's own description. Deprecated by OpenAI on 2026-10-01 (model and dated snapshot); removal from the API on 2027-04-01 (OpenAI deprecations page, checked 2026-10-25).

tiers.name: mini
tiers.notes: Mid tier: 'strongest mini model yet for coding, computer use, and subagents' per OpenAI's own description. No deprecation notice (checked 2026-10-25).

tiers.name: gpt-5.4
tiers.notes: Flagship GPT-5.4 tier: 'frontier model for complex professional work' per OpenAI's own description. Superseded on OpenAI's product line by GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 and GPT-6, but not deprecated (checked 2026-10-25) -- chosen here specifically for its dated snapshot, not because it is OpenAI's current top model.

reproducibility_caveat: gpt-5.4-nano and its snapshot gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17 were deprecated on 2026-10-01 and will be removed from the API on 2027-04-01 (replacement: gpt-6-luna); after that date the weak tier cannot be re-run on the same snapshot. gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 and gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 carry no deprecation notice (checked 2026-10-25). All three tiers carry a real dated snapshot ID, confirmed on OpenAI's per-model docs pages on 2026-08-27 and 2026-10-25. Superseded the earlier gpt-5.6-sol/terra/luna lock, which had no dated snapshot available for any tier (see model_snapshot_verification.md history).
